title: Dudani Retail IPO Details
intro:
Dudani Retail IPO is a fixed issue price of ₹10.54 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 36.36 lakh shares of ₹10.54 crore.

Dudani Retail IPO opens for subscription on Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Sep 29, 2026. The allotment for the Dudani Retail IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 30, 2026. Dudani Retail IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 5, 2026.

Dudani Retail IPO is set final issue price at ₹29 per share. The lot size for an application is 4,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,32,000 (8,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (12,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,48,000.

Finshore Management Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Prabhat Financial Services Ltd.

Refer to Dudani Retail IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in December 2015, Dudani Retail Limited is an apparel and lifestyle company engaged in the designing, manufacturing, sourcing and supply of apparel and related products through own-brand operations, licensed manufacturing arrangements with Fashion & Lifestyle marketplaces and a supply arrangement with a Quick-Commerce Platform. The Company’s own-brand business primarily focuses on women’s ethnic and fusion wear sold under the brand “Divena”, including suit sets, kurtas, dresses, tops, tunics, kaftans, co-ord sets, sarees and bottom wear. These products are designed and manufactured through a combination of in-house production and outsourced value-added processes. The Company also trades in men’s wear under “Millennial Men”, where finished goods are sourced from external suppliers and sold through online channels. It selectively trades in personal care and lifestyle products under “Cosse” based on sourcing opportunities and demand patterns.

In addition to its own-brand operations, the Company undertakes licensed manufacturing for Fashion & Lifestyle marketplaces, producing apparel against orders and according to specified design briefs, brand requirements and quality standards. The labels covered under these arrangements include Kalini, Corsica, Roadster, Anouk Rustic, All about you, Taavi, Navyaazri, Chandbaali, Baesd, ETC, Navibhu and Here & Now. The Company’s role is limited to manufacturing and supplying products on a just-in-time basis, while the intellectual property rights in these labels remain with the respective licensors.

The Company also supplies products to a Quick-Commerce Platform under a sell-or-return arrangement, where goods are delivered to designated hubs and payments are made periodically based on actual sales to end customers, after applicable margins. Its manufacturing facility in Jaipur, Rajasthan undertakes key processes including cutting, stitching, finishing, quality checks and dispatch, while fabric dyeing, printing, embroidery and other value-added processes are carried out through third-party processors.

The Company follows an integrated workflow covering design development, fabric and material procurement, sampling, manufacturing, outsourced processing, finishing and dispatch. Its products are distributed through multiple e-commerce marketplaces, including Myntra, Amazon, Flipkart, Ajio, Nykaa Fashion, Tata Cliq and Snapdeal, as well as through its own brand websites.
As on August 31, 2026, the Company had 33 permanent employees, including directors, supported by 35 temporary personnel primarily engaged in stitching and pressing activities.

Established supplier network for fabrics, trims and finished goods.
Multi-channel distribution through leading e-commerce marketplaces.
Established relationships with Fashion & Lifestyle companies through licensed manufacturing.

faqs.question: How to apply in Dudani Retail IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Dudani Retail IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Dudani Retail IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Dudani Retail IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Dudani Retail IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Dudani Retail IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Dudani Retail IPO opens on Fri, Sep 25, 2026 and closes on Tue, Sep 29, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Dudani Retail IPO?
faqs.answer: Dudani Retail IPO lot size is 4000 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,32,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Dudani Retail IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Dudani Retail IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Dudani Retail IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Dudani Retail IPO will be done on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Oct 1, 2026 . Check the Dudani Retail IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Dudani Retail IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Dudani Retail IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Oct 5, 2026 .
